subject.title: fix(ui): apply Context Profile presets via config.patch to avoid SecretRef rejection

question: Should Control UI continue to offer these four curated Context Profiles, with profile application blocked whenever Raw JSON has unsaved edits instead of attempting a cross-representation merge?
rationale: The patch is mechanically coherent, but the preset values and the deliberate Raw JSON restriction define operator-facing configuration policy rather than a purely mechanical bug repair.

options.title: Accept staged profiles and the Raw JSON block
options.body: Keep the narrow patch path and require operators to resolve or discard unsaved Raw JSON before applying a profile, preventing one representation from silently overwriting the other.

options.title: Keep the fix but remove profiles from this PR
options.body: Land only a narrower repair for the existing profile workflow if maintainers do not want curated Context Profile choices exposed in Quick Settings.

options.title: Design a formal cross-mode reconciliation flow
options.body: Pause this PR and specify a user-visible merge or confirmation workflow before allowing profiles to apply over independently edited Raw JSON.

recommendation.title: Accept staged profiles and the Raw JSON block
recommendation.body: Keep the narrow patch path and require operators to resolve or discard unsaved Raw JSON before applying a profile, preventing one representation from silently overwriting the other.
